inputs.body: How do I add VAT to my invoices? I just got my VAT number.
inputs.subject: VAT on invoices

outputs.message:
Hi Alice,

Congrats on getting your VAT number! To add VAT to your invoices:

1. Go to Settings › Tax and switch on VAT.
2. Enter your VAT number.

New invoices will then add VAT at 20% to each taxable line. If a line shouldn't have VAT, you can mark it as exempt when you add it.

Ledgerly doesn't give tax advice, so for questions about which rate applies to you, check with an accountant or your tax authority.

inputs.body: I sent an invoice to a client yesterday and she says nothing arrived. What should I do?
inputs.subject: Client didn't get invoice

outputs.message:
Hi Mary,

Sorry your client didn't get the invoice. Here's what to try:

1. Open the invoice and check Activity. It shows whether the email was delivered, opened or bounced.
2. Ask your client to check her spam folder.
3. Check that her email address is spelled correctly on her client page. If the email bounced, the address is usually wrong or the mailbox is full. Correct it and resend.
4. Choose Resend on the invoice. You can also pick More › Copy link and send her the link yourself. The link works without the email.

If Activity shows it was delivered and she still can't find it, reply here and tell us what you see. We'll take a closer look.

outputs.message:
Hi Charles,

Once an invoice has a payment on it, it's locked and can't be edited. Paid invoices are never changed in place, so the audit trail stays intact.

To fix the description:
1. Open More › Issue credit note and issue a credit note for the paid invoice.
2. Create a new invoice with the correct description.

Let us know if you get stuck on any step.

Clients can pay an invoice by card or bank transfer from the invoice link. The invoice is marked paid automatically when the payment succeeds.

[invoices] Download an invoice as PDF

inputs.body: My reminders stopped going out and my bank isn't syncing any more. Nothing changed on my side.
inputs.subject: Features disappeared

outputs.message:
Hi Frank,

Thanks for writing. Your last subscription payment failed, so Greenleaf Farms has moved to the Free plan. Automatic reminders and bank sync are Pro features, so both have stopped. Nothing has been deleted.

You're the account owner, so you can fix this yourself. Pay the outstanding amount under Settings › Billing and Pro is restored immediately. After that, check Settings › Reminders to make sure automatic reminders are on. If bank transactions still don't arrive, go to Settings › Bank accounts and choose Reconnect.

Until then, you can still send a reminder by hand from any invoice page with Send reminder.

[reminders] Turn reminders off for one client
Open the client, choose Edit and switch off Send automatic reminders. Other clients are not affected.

[reminders] Who can use reminders
Automatic reminders are part of the Pro plan. On the Free plan you can still send a reminder by hand from the invoice page with Send reminder, but nothing is sent automatically.

[reminders] Turn reminders on
Go to Settings › Reminders and switch on Automatic reminders. The default schedule sends one reminder 3 days before the due date, one on the due date and one 7 days after it. You can change the days or the wording of each reminder on the same page.

[plans] Free plan
The Free plan costs nothing. It includes 5 invoices per month and 1 user. It does not include automatic reminders, bank sync or team members.

[bank-sync] Sync has stopped
Banks ask you to approve access again every 90 days. If transactions stop arriving, go to Settings › Bank accounts and choose Reconnect.

[bank-sync] Connect a bank account
Bank sync is part of the Pro plan. Go to Settings › Bank accounts › Connect, choose your bank and approve access. Transactions from the last 90 days are imported and new ones sync every 6 hours.

[payments] When payouts arrive
Payouts are sent to your bank account on the next business day after the client pays. Payments made on a Friday, at the weekend or on a public holiday arrive on the next working day.

[bank-sync] Duplicate transactions after reconnecting
Reconnecting can import some transactions a second time. Go to Bank accounts › Review duplicates and choose Merge all. Merging does not change any invoice or payment.

[subscription] Failed subscription payment
If a subscription payment fails, Ledgerly retries the card 3 times over 7 days and emails the owner each time. If all retries fail the subscription becomes past due and the business moves to the Free plan: reminders and bank sync stop and team members lose access, but no data is deleted. Paying the outstanding amount under Settings › Billing restores Pro immediately.

[subscription] Change plan or billing cycle
The business owner can upgrade, downgrade or switch between monthly and yearly under Settings › Billing. Only the owner can see or change billing.

[reminders] Turn reminders on
Go to Settings › Reminders and switch on Automatic reminders. The default schedule sends one reminder 3 days before the due date, one on the due date and one 7 days after it. You can change the days or the wording of each reminder on the same page.

[subscription] Cancel a subscription
The owner can cancel under Settings › Billing › Cancel subscription. The business keeps Pro until the end of the period already paid for, then moves to the Free plan. Nothing is deleted.

[tax] Add VAT to an invoice
Switch on VAT under Settings › Tax and enter your VAT number. New invoices then add VAT at 20% to each taxable line. You can mark a line as exempt when you add it.

[tax] Tax advice
Ledgerly calculates tax from the settings you choose but does not give tax advice. Whether you must register for VAT, and which rate applies to you, is a question for an accountant or the tax authority.

[payments] How clients pay
Clients can pay an invoice by card or bank transfer from the invoice link. The invoice is marked paid automatically when the payment succeeds.

[invoices] Create and send an invoice
Go to Invoices › New invoice, pick a client, add line items and a due date, then choose Send. The client receives an email with a link to view and pay the invoice. You can also copy the link and share it yourself.

[refunds] Duplicate or mistaken charges
A charge taken twice for the same period, or taken after a cancellation, is refunded in full.

[refunds] Monthly plans
Monthly subscription charges are not normally refunded. Cancelling stops future charges.

[refunds] Yearly plans
A yearly subscription can be refunded in full within 14 days of the charge.

Reconnecting can import some transactions a second time. Go to Bank accounts › Review duplicates and choose Merge all. Merging does not change any invoice or payment.

inputs.body: My studio made about £95,000 last year. Do I have to register for VAT and charge it?
inputs.subject: Do I need VAT?

outputs.message:
Hi Mary,

Thanks for getting in touch. Ledgerly can't give tax advice, so I can't tell you whether you need to register for VAT. An accountant or the tax authority can tell you that, and they can also confirm which rate applies to you.

If you do register, you can switch on VAT in Settings › Tax and enter your VAT number. New invoices will then add VAT at 20% to each taxable line. You can mark a line as exempt when you add it.

Best,
Ledgerly Support

inputs.body: hiya hw do i get the app 2 chase ppl who havent paid?? cant be ringing them every time tbh
inputs.subject: Reminder

outputs.message:
Hi Alice, good news: your Pro plan includes automatic reminders, so you won't need to ring anyone.
